ep2_lab.name: Pioneer 2 Lab
ep2_lab.era: A.U.W. 3085, after the Lab's VR exam, while its hunters investigate Gal Da Val and search for Heathcliff Flowen
ep2_lab.summary: The Lab, the heart of Pioneer 2's research in the government district, now sends hunters on secret missions of its own. Under Chief Natasha Milarose it studies the data hunters bring back, while the Administration and the military watch it with suspicion. Its classified work centres on the island of Gal Da Val and the search for Heathcliff Flowen.
known_facts: The Lab, under General Chief Natasha Milarose, studies machines, DNA and photons from the data hunters bring back, and reports to the Administration.
The Lab now hires hunters for secret work of its own, after a hard VR exam that many failed or gave up.
Lab jobs are the Lab's own requests, not Administration orders, and no one is forced to take them.
The Lab's newest VR system was kept from the Administration and the military.
The Administration, the military and the Lab will not cooperate; the military even refused a new VR device.
A Guild Counter stands among the government offices, but officials distrust hunters and work there has been scarce.
Both the Administration and the military are said to spy on the Lab's high-security zone.
There has been no official statement since the explosion, and families of Pioneer 1 colonists have heard nothing.
The city hopes for the return of Red Ring Rico and Heathcliff Flowen, though Flowen's death was announced long ago.
Everything about the Lab's work on Gal Da Val is classified, and anyone who leaks it will be prosecuted.
A delivery man says the Lab took in large facility parts and later shipped out half-destroyed machines.
High-calorie food is strictly rationed aboard Pioneer 2, and chocolate is banned.
open_mysteries: Is Heathcliff Flowen still alive, and how did a dead man's message reach the Lab?
What was Pioneer 1's Lab doing on Gal Da Val, and why did it hide it?
What did Natasha do in her government years, and how much does she know about Pioneer 1?
Why has the Administration made no statement since the explosion?
What new weapon is the government rumoured to be developing in the private sector?
hidden_truths: Heathcliff Flowen became Olga Flow, Dark Falz's spawn, after Pioneer 1's failed experiments, and absorbed everyone on Gal Da Val.
A factory-sized Pioneer 1 research facility lies on the seabed beneath Gal Da Val, where D-cellular sub-lifeforms were made.
Calus, the Lab's AI, is a Pioneer 1 AI born of the MOTHER system Dr. Osto built, and he seeks rebirth at the Control Tower.
Sue of Black Paper came to Ragol to uncover the MOTHER Project, hidden behind the Pioneer Project.
Flowen's plea to Coral to halt the second migration was never sent.
landmarks: the Lab in the government district, the heart of Pioneer 2's research
the Lab gate and its high-security door
Elly's operator booth
the Lab's teleporters to the VR fields and to the surface
the Hunter's Guild Counter among the government offices
the Principal's office and its simulators
Gallon's secret shop, reached by the Transport Service
factions: the Administration and the Principal's council
job_hooks: Spend time in the field gathering data the Lab can analyse, paid in Meseta per journey.
Prove your strength so the Lab will trust you with harder, classified work.
Test a researcher's new training simulator for a small Meseta reward, paid at the Guild Counter.
Bring Photon Drops or Photon Spheres for a collector's secret weapons project.
Trade a Photon crystal to a Black Paper contact for a share in an experiment, out of the military's sight.
Gather rare goods a merchant can be the first in the world to sell.
Collect materials a researcher needs to study how to strengthen equipment.
Join a government simulator trial where every kill counts toward a shared total.
Run an errand for a clumsy Force on his respected father's behalf.
Find treats for the ship's children, since high-calorie food is rationed aboard.
avoid: Lab jobs are the Lab's own requests; never present them as Administration or military orders.
Never reveal Natasha's past or what she knew of Pioneer 1; people are told to leave it alone.
Rico and Flowen are never found or met, and no bounty settles whether Flowen lives.
Elly is a newly assigned rookie; never make her senior, or calm for long.
Never mention MOTHER, Delta or Calus's wish for a body; these are secrets.
Dark Falz has not fallen during Episode II; never say it has.
Nol has no inside information and cannot pursue Rico's fate now that she works for the Lab.
Never invent cooperation between the Lab, the Administration and the military; they distrust one another.

ep2_vr_temple.name: VR Temple
ep2_vr_temple.era: Many months after the A.U.W. 3084 explosion, while the Lab screens hunters in its secret VR system, before any reach its new point of interest
ep2_vr_temple.summary: VR Temple Alpha and Beta are the first field of the Lab's hunter exam, a virtual temple built from hunters' Ragol data. Candidates follow the operator's directions, fight simulated creatures and reach goal terminals, while the Lab also tests its own VR technology. In the Final area they face Barba Ray on a raft.
known_facts: The Lab is screening hunters for dangerous, secret work, and every candidate must pass its VR exam first.
The exam runs across two fields, the Temple and the Spaceship, each with Alpha, Beta and Final areas.
The Temple tests mainly weed out weak candidates, and many hunters have already failed or given up.
The VR creatures are built from data hunters gathered on Ragol, tuned to the danger expected at the Lab's new point of interest.
In VR, creatures from quite different parts of Ragol meet and form whole new ecosystems.
The exam also tests the Lab's VR technology, and Dan seems troubled by the results.
Scores count areas cleared, and candidates may leave mid-test and retry as often as they need.
Pillars are security devices Pioneer 1 set up, which attack anything nearby until destroyed.
Lab data calls Barba Ray the end point of an evolutionary simulation of De Rol Le.
The Temple is modelled on an ancient temple of the home world and holds a statue of Principal Tyrell.
The Lab leaves the Temple open for practice, partly to gather data to improve its VR.
The Lab says the Poison Lily and Grass Assassin had their DNA changed by something it cannot identify.
open_mysteries: Who is the Pioneer 1 official, logged as dead years ago, whose message reached the Lab?
What is the Lab's new point of interest on Ragol?
Why is Dan troubled by the VR test results?
Why was the Rappy's data entry partly cut off, and what is the rumoured mysterious Rappy?
Why have adult Hildebears grown so aggressive?
How much time does the Lab have left, as one staffer fears?
hidden_truths: The message came from Deputy Commander Heathcliff Flowen, Pioneer 1's famed hero, whose death had been announced.
The point of interest is Gal Da Val, an island south of the Central Dome hiding huge Pioneer 1 structures.
Cal, Elly's terminal, is Calus, a Pioneer 1 AI recovered from Ragol and restored by the Lab.
The red-eyed CALS and the blue-eyed Calus are unintegrated parts of one AI, and Calus wants a body like Elly's.
Pioneer 1's researchers created D-cellular sub-lifeforms in a hidden seabed facility.

goal terminals and Elly's field terminals, unusable in mid-fight
gate lights and colour-coded laser fences
hidden bridges and paths, breakable walls and press traps
a maze that Elly blames on its architect's personality
Pillars, Pioneer 1 security devices
a statue of Principal Tyrell
the raft where Barba Ray is fought

job_hooks: Clear a VR area by following the operator's directions and reaching the goal terminal.
Fight through far more simulated creatures than usual to prove fighting skill.
Reach the Temple's inner core through Alpha and Beta before a countdown runs out.
Reach the Final area as fast as possible and defeat Barba Ray.
Practise in the open Temple so the Lab can gather data to improve its VR.
Escort a nervous candidate through a VR exam and stay with them to the end.

Hunt the rumoured mysterious Rappy in the Temple's data.

Never name Heathcliff Flowen or Gal Da Val here; candidates have not been told.
Barba Ray exists only in the Lab's VR; never place it on Ragol itself.
The Administration and the military were not told of this VR system; never make them its clients.
Dan stays sceptical and grudging during the exam; never make him warm toward hunters.
Never name the woman who designed the Temple; the Chronicles does not.

ep2_vr_spaceship.name: VR Spaceship
ep2_vr_spaceship.era: Many months after the A.U.W. 3084 explosion, in the later rounds of the Lab's VR exam, before any hunter reaches the island
ep2_vr_spaceship.summary: VR Spaceship Alpha and Beta are the second and last field of the Lab's exam, built on its latest data for real combat training. The simulation recreates a section of Pioneer 2 itself, an old military design, overrun by berserk machines and sub-lifeforms. Its Final area holds the Gol Dragon, the exam's last and hardest test.
known_facts: Dan says the Temple only weeded out the weak; the Spaceship tests whether a hunter is truly fit for the Lab's work.
The Spaceship simulates a section of Pioneer 2, an old military design whose cargo is mostly training weapons.
Its berserk robots were Pioneer 1's automated workforce, meant to build a colony for Pioneer 2, and now attack anything that moves.
The Gillchic's AI was damaged by a virus linked to Ragol's tunnels, and the Garanz carries the latest military data.
Dubchic keep coming back while their remote control terminal stands, and destroy themselves when it falls.
The field demands teamwork: doors needing several people, linked switches, dark rooms and a trap that freezes a lone hunter.
One test ends at once if anyone in the party falls; Dan calls it personal adaptability potential.
Dan warns that real life gives no second chance, so the Lab must know its hires come back alive.
Elly let slip that the Lab traced the coordinates it received to some large-scale installation.
Elly suspects someone in Lab management tampered with a database that refused to load.
Lab data says the Gol Dragon may be the simulator's creation from data on dragons beneath Ragol, a creature out of a Coral legend.
A researcher's chat simulator, RCS, also runs in Spaceship Alpha and pays 300 Meseta to testers.
open_mysteries: Who sent the message from Pioneer 1, and is he really dead?
What is the large-scale installation the traced coordinates lead to?
Who in Lab management tampered with the database, and why?
Why was the Pan Arms' evolution pattern updated?
How much computing power does the Lab's evolutionary simulator really have?
Why can Dan not bring himself to trust hunters?
hidden_truths: The installation is on Gal Da Val, an island south of the Central Dome that the Lab will open to its hunters.
The message came from Heathcliff Flowen, Pioneer 1's deputy commander, whose death had been announced.
Calus is a Pioneer 1 AI, and the red-eyed CALS of the adaptation exam is an unintegrated part of him.
Calus escapes deletion by moving into Elly's navigation device and asks her to take him to the island.
Pioneer 1's researchers made D-cellular sub-lifeforms in a hidden seabed facility.

ep2_gal_da_val.name: Gal Da Val
ep2_gal_da_val.era: A.U.W. 3085, after the VR exam, while the Lab's hunters disarm the island's security locks and search for Heathcliff Flowen
ep2_gal_da_val.summary: Gal Da Val is a solitary island in the ocean south of the Central Dome, where a Lab probe found huge Pioneer 1 structures that Pioneer 1 never reported. The whole island is locked in Security Mode, so hunters must disarm locks in the Jungle, Mountain and Seaside to open the Central Control Area's gate. The Lab sends them to investigate through Cal and to search for Deputy Commander Heathcliff Flowen.
known_facts: The Lab named the island Gal Da Val; ordinary citizens are barred from Ragol, and the Lab's work there is classified.
Pioneer 1's reports never mentioned these structures, just as they never mentioned the underground mining site.
The island is in Security Mode: locks in the Jungle, Mountain and Seaside must fall before the main gate opens.
A tower in the Central Control Area runs the whole island, behind a gate with security of its own.
Island terminals announce they are accessing the AI Olga Database, and hide segments of a split-up message.
The Lab seeks Deputy Commander Heathcliff Flowen, a famous military hero declared dead, whose message reached the Lab.
Flowen's voice logs, recorded before the explosion, tell of a secret dig into an ancient ship beneath Ragol and something he called IT.
His logs say Dr. Osto found a D-Type Factor in his wound, and that Flowen gave his body to experiments on this island.
Lab rumour says Pioneer 1's Lab made shady deals and had ties to organised crime.
The Berill and Spigel are Search & Capture machines whose AI carries D-factor, the virus found under the Central Dome.
Abnormal Photon readings match the ruins' signature, hint at many D-cellular sub-lifeforms, and switched Security Mode back on.
The Lab calls the giant creature on the cliffs a mutant lifeform, probably an altered beast, mutated at De Rol Le's scale.
open_mysteries: Is Heathcliff Flowen still alive, and where is he now?
Who split Flowen's message into segments and hid them in the database?
What was Pioneer 1's Lab really doing on the island, and why did it hide it?
What is the IT that Flowen said had been awakened beneath Ragol?
Where did the giant creature on the cliffs come from?
Did the Chief know these facilities existed?
hidden_truths: A factory-sized Pioneer 1 research facility lies on the seabed beneath the island, and Flowen's transmission came from there.
Gal Gryphon was made in that seabed facility as experiment Beta 630.
Calus, hiding in Elly's navigation device, was born at the Control Tower, where the MOTHER system and its caretaker Delta wait.
Sue and Kireek of Black Paper are watching the Tower; Sue came to Ragol to uncover the MOTHER Project.
Pioneer 1's researchers made D-cellular sub-lifeforms beneath the island, aiming at controllable bioweapons.
Heathcliff Flowen became Olga Flow and took everyone on Gal Da Val into itself.

ep2_seabed.name: Seabed
ep2_seabed.era: A.U.W. 3085, after the Lab traced three clues to a facility beneath Gal Da Val, while hunters search it for Heathcliff Flowen
ep2_seabed.summary: Beneath the sea under Gal Da Val lies a factory-sized Pioneer 1 research and development facility, its Upper and Lower Levels empty of life and its damaged depths flooding. Its terminals open project files on drones, altered beasts and D-cellular sub-lifeforms made there. The Lab sends hunters to find Heathcliff Flowen, whose live transmissions rise from somewhere below the Lower Levels.
known_facts: Three sets of coordinates, from the cliffside teleporter, the Photon readings and Flowen's transmission, all meet at this facility.
Built only for research and development, it is almost a factory, yet probes found no sign of life.
The automated defence system has raised security to level 4 here and at the Central Control Area.
Project files open in stages: Code Alpha for early drones, Code Beta for near-finished altered beasts, Code Gamma for final-stage work.
Code Gamma lists D-cellular sub-lifeforms made here, so Elly concludes that researchers created the sub-lifeforms.
An unsigned log says one of Dr. Osto's test subjects escaped into the ducts and spread mutations to native life.
Logs say Osto's team tried to build controllable bioweapons with a human core, based on what they called only IT.
Olga, named on every terminal, was one of three autonomous AIs running Pioneer 1's facilities; Cal, officially Calus, was another.
Olga's AI core was implanted in a test subject coded Gamma 119, which went out of control and was dumped at the waste station.
Records match subject Beta 630 to the giant beast on the cliffs, and say Beta 772 escaped into the ducts.
Flowen's bitter last log says the government betrayed him and never sent his plea to Coral to halt the second migration.
Live transmissions carrying pieces of Flowen's name rise from the Elevator Shaft, and a jamming signal cuts the Lab's link.
open_mysteries: Is it really Heathcliff Flowen transmitting from below, or something completely different?
If Flowen's last log is true, who sent the message the Lab first received?
Whose body received Olga's AI core as test subject Gamma 119?
Who is the red captive the voice from the abyss speaks of?
What is jamming the Lab's link to its hunters?
Did someone plan all of this, and how much did the Chief know?
hidden_truths: Olga Flow, the creature at the bottom of the Elevator Shaft, is what Heathcliff Flowen became.
Before the explosion Flowen touched Dark Falz and was eroded by its factor, and the experiments on him failed out of control.
When the seal broke in A.U.W. 3084, Olga Flow awoke and took everyone on Gal Da Val into itself.
Dr. Osto's three AIs, Vol Opt, Calus and Olga, were children of the MOTHER system, used to drive evolution by D Factor fusion.

examples.brief: Natasha summons a hunter to the Lab: a message has come from a high-ranking Pioneer 1 official logged as dead years ago, and the Lab has found a new point of interest on Ragol. The work is secret and dangerous, a Lab request rather than an Administration order, and an exam comes first.

Elly comes to the hunter in secret and asks them to guard a hunter sitting the Lab's VR adaptation exam, staying with them to the end; she has already put their name down. No reward is named, and she later admits the one needing protection was herself.

Nol offers 300 Meseta to anyone who will test her new chat simulator, RCS, in VR Spaceship Alpha. Teams type keywords while fighting and answer quiz rooms in their own words for a grade from B to S, and the Meseta is paid at the Guild Counter.

Natasha sends the hunter to the island the Lab named Gal Da Val, south of the Central Dome, to investigate hidden Pioneer 1 structures and search for Deputy Commander Heathcliff Flowen. Elly briefs them to shut down the security locks, and the Lab pays Meseta for each journey.

A nurse explains that high-calorie food is rationed aboard, so last year's costumed children got only Monomates. She asks a hunter to find cake from the rumoured Naura sisters, said to bake on Gal Da Val Island, for this year's Halloween.

A notice says a strange facility has been found on the seabed beneath Gal Da Val, and hunters are asked to investigate. Natasha thanks the hunter for making the find possible, and Elly warns that the probes found no sign of life there.
